summary: Adds evidence-backed, device-specific non-trace CMSIS-Pack Debug Description sequences to an existing Device Family Pack PDSC. Records proposed debugvars and .dbgconf proposals in a private record, applies the confirmed change, and reports applicability, placement, evidence, low-power behavior, and validation results.
triggers: reset or bootloader sequence in PDSC
verification: Read [the debug-sequence contract](references/debug-sequence-contract.md) in full before assembly.

Use `$validate-pdsc-sequence-xml` for common PDSC checks, compare overridden predefined sequences with current specification defaults, and perform documented low-power checks when a target is available.
stop_conditions: Stop when the knowledge record is inadequate, a required specification default is unavailable, confirmation is absent, or any validation fails.
Return insufficient access facts to `$debug-access-knowledge` and behavior facts to `$debug-knowledge`.
Present it with the proposed XML and obtain confirmation.
Do not modify `.dbgconf` without explicit confirmation.
Set `APPLIED` only after all checks pass.

rules.delta: Applies to reset, unlock, authentication, boot, flash, processor-control, low-power, register, delay, and connection behavior.
